As research vessels can easily accommodate a fully grown beast, they must be at least higher than 97 meters |mass= |max accel= |mglt= |max speed= |maneuverability= |engine= |hyperdrive=[[Hyperdrive|Equipped]] |hdrange= |hdsystem= |poweroutput= |power= |shield gen= |hull= |sensor= |target= |navigation= |avionics= |maincomp= |countermeasures= |armament=Ventral-mounted [[NNJ-40 "Thunderbolt" long-range ion cannon]] |complement= |bays= |escapepods= |crew=*At least 1 Imperial [[clone commando]] *At least one [[Imperial nanny droid|medical droid]] |skeleton= |passengers= |capacity= |cargohandling= |consumables= |lifesupport=[[Life support|Equipped]] |communications= |othersystems= |role=Containment and transport of [[Zillo Beast]] [[Cloning|clones]] |commission= |destroyed=During or after [[18 BBY]]{{TBBDate|211}} |retired= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Advanced Science Division]] |navy= |fleet= |owners= |captains= |registry=904 |aliases= }} {{Quote|We lost communication with transport 904.|[[Emerie Karr]], to [[Royce Hemlock]]|}} '''Transport 904''' was a, [[Imperial research transport]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. During or after [[18 BBY]], it was bound for the [[planet]] [[Wayland]] and the new [[Tantiss Base|facilities]] there when its cargo, a [[Cloning|cloned]] [[Zillo Beast]], broke loose and drastically damaged the ship. The crippled vessel dropped out of [[hyperspace]] and crash-landed on [[Silla]]. The [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] caught wind of the vessel's state and sent [[Clone Force 99]] to scavenge its cargo, unaware of what it was carrying. ==Role== {{Quote|What kind if ship is this?''"
"''Don't know. No hull markings.|Wrecker and Hunter|}} Transport 904 was a [[Imperial research transport|science vessel]] tasked with delivering a [[Cloning|cloned]] [[Zillo Beast]] to an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Tantiss Base|cloning facility]] on [[Mount Tantiss]] on the [[planet]] [[Wayland]]. The vessel's route was not charted into the ship's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] due to the clandestine nature of the [[Imperial cloning program]]. It's hull had no discernable markings so it could not be identified to the organization. ==History== {{Quote|Something unfortunate happened here.|Tech observes the inside of the transport|}} During or after [[18 BBY]], transport 904 was on route to the planet of Wayland when its cargo, a cloned juvenile Zillo Beast, broke free of its containment and attacked the vessel's crew. After it consumed almost all of the ship's crew and damaged it to the point of ripping it out of [[hyperspace]], the Zillo Beast chased down a surviving Imperial [[clone commando]] through the ship's hallways. As the commando readied an [[electrostaff]] and prepared to stand his ground against the creature, the beast ambushed the commando and pulled him into the ceiling shafts screaming, where he was killed and consumed. The ship would eventually crash-land on [[Silla]]. Not long after, the rogue clones of [[Clone Force 99]] received word from their associate, [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], about the ship's crash and were sent to recover any valuable cargo it might carry. They found and boarded the ship, but after exploring it they soon came across the cloned Zillo Beast, who attacked them. The team managed to force the beast to retreat into a nearby forest by throwing a grenade at it, which blew a hole in the ship and allowed it to escape. As [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] pursued the creature aboard the ''[[Marauder (Omicron-class)|Marauder]]'', [[Tech]] and [[Omega]] returned to the wreckage of transport 904 and attempted to extract information from its database. The two were eventually forced to flee as Imperial [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wing starfighters]] sent to respond to the crash destroyed the transport to prevent its purpose from being known. ==Behind the scenes== Transport 904 first appeared in "[[Metamorphosis (episode)|Metamorphosis]]," the eleventh episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' [[Bad Batch Season 2|season two]]. The image of Transport 904 from the reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' incorrectly depicts another science vessel that was docked at Mount Tantiss after Transport 904 crashed onto Silla.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Metamorphosis (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Transporte 904 |ja=輸送船904 |ka=გადამყვანი 904 }} [[Category:Imperial science vessels]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Empire]]
